tools.name: get_profile_sharing_guidance
tools.summary: Get the correct Linktree profile URL and steps for adding it to a social bio; does not edit or verify the bio.
tools.description: Get the selected Linktree profile URL and guidance for putting it in a social bio or website field. Use when the creator asks how to share their Linktree or, after a successful link update, when bio placement is relevant to their stated traffic goal. Sharing means adding the Linktree profile URL to the social profile, not drafting captions or posts. This tool does not edit social profiles or verify bio placement. Do not claim the URL has been added. If the creator already has the correct URL in their bio, no change is needed. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

tools.name: pull_recommendations
tools.summary: Retrieve available Linktree recommendations for a profile and claim the ones returned for the public MCP.
tools.description: Use this tool whenever the creator asks for suggestions or ideas, or asks what to do, improve or change on their Linktree. If they mention a focus, pass it as `topic`. Retrieve up to three available recommendations for a Linktree profile. Treat each recommendation as input for reasoning, not as text to paste to the creator: understand what it changes, use public read tools such as get_links, get_account, get_appearance, get_social_links, and get_link_analytics for context when needed, explain it in your own words, and propose a concrete action. Only use write tools such as add_link, update_link, upsert_social_link, and update_appearance after the creator agrees. `items` is the same recommendations as unified items (id, status, headline, summary, why, facts, action); prefer it when present. Track the creator's decision on each item and always submit it afterward with submit_recommendation_feedback (dismiss_all if they are not interested in a recommendation). If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recommendations to retrieve. Defaults to 3.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query for discovery or disambiguation. Matches username, display name, or real name.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: What the creator wants help with, in their words (e.g. 'grow my newsletter', 'sell more merch'). Omit for general suggestions.

tools.name: submit_recommendation_feedback
tools.summary: Record the creator's per-item decision (acted or dismissed) on a pulled recommendation.
tools.description: Record the creator's decision on a recommendation returned by pull_recommendations. Always call it after the creator acts on or declines a pulled recommendation, including when they decline. Send one item per recommendation item you discussed, using the item ids and kinds from the recommendation, with outcome acted (adopted as suggested), acted_with_edits (adopted with changes) or dismissed. For acted items, set link_id to the id of the link you actually created or updated. Example: a recommendation suggests 5 products and the creator adds 2 and skips 3, so send 2 items with outcome acted, signal added_to_profile and the new link_id, plus 3 items with outcome dismissed and signal explicit_dismiss. If the creator is not interested in the recommendation at all, set dismiss_all to true (items may then be empty). Only tell the creator feedback was recorded when this tool confirms it. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

tools.summary: Add a new URL-backed link to a Linktree profile.
tools.description: Add a new URL-backed link to a Linktree profile. Supports optional title, link type, active state, target position, and duplicate suppression. The result may include needsLinkTypeChoice: true; if so, present its options to the creator and call add_link again with their selected linkType. It may include needsSetup: true; if so, relay the warning and editUrl so the creator can finish setup in the editor. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`. tools.name: update_link
tools.summary: Update an existing link or collection on a Linktree profile (title, URL, or active state).
tools.description: Update an existing link or collection on a Linktree profile. Works on top-level links, links inside a collection, and the collection itself. Supports sparse updates to title, URL, and active state; collections do not support URL updates. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`. After a successful update, if putting their Linktree URL in a social bio is relevant to the creator's stated goal, get_profile_sharing_guidance can return the correct profile URL and placement steps; pass the same explicit username, profileUrl, query, or workspaceUuid target as the update, even if another profile is active or default. Do not repeat the suggestion if already completed or declined.

errorContract.envelope: Errors are returned as an MCP tool result with `isError: true` and a single text content block containing JSON: `{ "error": "<CODE>", "message": "<human-readable>" }`. Some codes carry extra fields (e.g. PROFILE_REQUIRED adds `candidates` and `nextAction`).

codes.description: The caller has multiple accessible profiles (or none selected) and must choose one. The envelope includes `candidates` and a `nextAction`.
A referenced resource (link, collection, integration, account) does not exist.
A parameter was missing, empty, or invalid for the requested operation.
The request is missing required identity/authorization headers or the token cannot act on the target.
The caller exceeded the public MCP rate limit. Retry after backing off.
The tool or requested option requires a paid Linktree plan.
The link displays the title of its linked Shop product, which link mutations cannot write. Rename the product in Shop instead. Nothing was changed.
The link does not meet the featured layout prerequisites: a non-SVG image thumbnail that is not an icon, and no animation. Nothing was changed.
The image URL could not be copied into Linktree-hosted storage, so it was not used. Nothing was changed. Use a different, publicly reachable image URL.
A downstream Linktree service returned an error while handling the request.
An unclassified error occurred. Safe to retry once; report if it persists.

example.message: Multiple accessible Linktree profiles are available. Call set_active_profile with a username to choose one for this conversation, or pass username/profileUrl on this call.

nextAction.hint: Call set_active_profile with { username } to stick this profile for the rest of the conversation, or pass username/profileUrl on each call.
